### BEFORE YOU REPORT YOUR BUG
Unless you are reporting a compatibility bug with *one* other mod, ensure the issue is reproducable with only Radiocraft and it's officially supported mods (SVC, Geckolib, ThatOneProbe Create, etc), and note which of those you have installed. **We will not accept bug reports if you have a bunch of mods installed as it is impossible to troubleshoot**.

**Brief Summary**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. When I do this, this happens.

**How do you reproduce this bug?**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**What do you expect to happen?**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

**Any Logs or screenshots?**
